summary: Entergy Corp filed an 8-K reporting the physical settlement of ATM and underwritten forward sale agreements. On June 22, 2026, it delivered 2,057,826 shares under ATM forward agreements for ~$126M cash, settling all outstanding ATM forwards, and 6,650,417 shares under underwritten forward agreements for ~$546M. Post-settlement, 11,145,984 shares remain under underwritten forwards (proceeds ~$915M), plus 19,247,788 additional shares from May 5, 2026 agreements. The forward sales, disclosed in annual/quarterly reports, effectively raise capital through equity forwards. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date cited. Watch potential dilution impact and additional settlements.
